help.title: How to give the server access
help.synology: In DSM open Control Panel › Shared Folder, select the shared folder, choose Edit › Permissions, pick “System internal user” in the drop-down, tick Read only for {{user}}, save, then reopen this folder list.
help.docker: Mount the folder into the container below /media (for example {{example}}) and restart the container.
help.standard: Give the user {{user}} read access to the folder.
